hero.headline: Learning in public,
hero.intro: Hi, I'm Konstrukturmx. I started coding recently and got hooked fast. I build a bit of everything: native tools in Rust, web apps, 3D in the browser, backend APIs. A jack of all trades, master of none… yet.

about.title: About Konstrukturmx
about.subtitle: A self-taught developer who learns by building and shares everything in the open.
philosophy: I started coding recently, and it went from curiosity to obsession faster than I expected. I learn by shipping: pick a real problem, build something, break it, fix it, and publish it. Every project teaches me something the tutorials skipped.

I'm a generalist at heart. Rust when I want fast native tools, TypeScript and React for the web, PHP and SQL on the server, three.js when a page deserves a third dimension. I'd rather understand how the whole stack fits together than know one corner of it perfectly — at least for now.

Open source is where I learn the most. I read other people's code, open issues, and put my own work out there for anyone to use, fork, or improve. If something I built helps you, or you spot a way to make it better, open an issue or a pull request — I'd love to hear from you.
about.quote: Jack of all trades, master of none, but oftentimes better than a master of one.

timeline.title: Started building in public
timeline.description: Joined GitHub and began publishing what I build, from first experiments to finished tools, so anyone can follow along, learn from my mistakes, or help.

timeline.title: WinBlast-Optimizer
timeline.description: A Windows system optimizer and debloater written in Rust. My first project with versioned releases, and my crash course in systems programming.

timeline.title: This website
timeline.description: A live dashboard of everything I ship: React, three.js and GSAP on the front end, a PHP API and GitHub Actions behind it, updated automatically from my GitHub.

contact.title: Contact & Collab
contact.subtitle: Questions, collaboration ideas or feedback on a project? Send a message and I'll get back to you.
contact.availability: Open to open-source collaboration, feedback on my projects and small builds. Always happy to learn from others.
